title: Who named Antarctica? Twenty thousand place names, the nations that gave them and the people they honour
excerpt: I mapped 20,151 Antarctic place names by who named them, when and after whom. America and Britain named 46% of the continent, and only 3.4% of the people honoured are women.
seo_description: Who named Antarctica? 20,151 place names mapped by naming nation, decade and namesake. The US and UK named 46%.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Who named Antarctica?' in black and red on parchment, beside a polar map of Antarctica dotted in the colours of the nations that named each feature, with the lines '46% named by the United States and Britain' and 'Only 3.4% of the people honoured are women'.
